title: Zenoh SHM and CRDT

contracts.typed_shm: Versioned tenant-bound immutable frame views retain an Arc allocation and validate range, size and SHA-256 before consumption.
contracts.crdt: Deterministic tenant-scoped LWW map with actor dots, Lamport ordering, explicit tombstones, replay rejection and bounded delta/version-vector exchange.
contracts.authority_boundary: CRDT is explicitly non-authoritative and cannot replace lease, fencing, authorization or payment state.

limitations: This artifact verifies the local typed frame contract; a real Zenoh SHM provider and cross-host benchmark still require their own environment.
No CRDT operation is an authorization, fencing, lease or payment decision.
